lead.title: Neo Medical deploys its Posterior MIS Access system in Europe for the first time, at Uniklinik RWTH Aachen
lead.deck: The Swiss company's minimally invasive access system begins its first European deployment at Uniklinik RWTH Aachen, the starting point of a multicenter study with three other German institutions (BG Klinikum Bergmannstrost Halle, Universitätsmedizin Halle, Charité Berlin). Neo Medical launched the platform in the US in July 2026, claiming no capital outlay for the hospital: Europe is now its clinical test.

milestone.title: SUBCUT-HF II: subcutaneous furosemide via a patch pump cuts hospital time in heart failure (JACC)
milestone.summary: Randomized trial of 172 patients at NHS hospitals: early discharge on Lasix ONYU (92 patients) versus usual inpatient care (80). The primary endpoint, days alive and out of hospital at 30 days, improved by 4.0 days (95% CI 2.1-5.8; p<0.001), with no device-related serious adverse event.
milestone.why: A drug-device combination (an abdominal patch pump approved by the FDA in October 2025) that moves hospital days to the home: a direct economic argument for payers, backed by a European trial published in a top-tier journal.

brefsEurope.title: WHO grants emergency use listing to bioMérieux's BioFire special pathogens panel for Bundibugyo virus
brefsEurope.summary: The BioFire Defense panel (a bioMérieux subsidiary) detects 16 pathogens, including Ebola, Marburg and Lassa, from a single blood sample in about an hour; it is the fifth test to receive the listing since the emergency was declared in May 2026. As of October 18, the DRC had reported 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. A market comparable more than an entry opportunity.

brefsEurope.title: Aspivix makes its carevix device available to all Afaxys members in the United States
brefsEurope.summary: The agreement opens the cervical stabilization device (IUD placement and other transcervical procedures) to community and public health providers in the Afaxys network: one more US channel after the commercial opening of October 2025.

brefsIntl.title: Masimo wins FDA clearance for the PPG AFib feature of its Radius VSM monitor
brefsIntl.summary: The feature uses AI to analyze the pulse waveform and flag atrial fibrillation, guiding clinicians toward an ECG or telemetry. It follows the June 2026 clearance for opioid-induced respiratory depression detection; Masimo is now a Danaher subsidiary. A comparable for photoplethysmography-based detection.

word.definition: A set of techniques that treat the spine through small incisions, moving muscle aside rather than cutting it, for less bleeding and faster recovery.

parts.label: Approach
parts.role: the small incision and working channel (tubular retractor)

parts.label: Instruments & implants
parts.role: screws, rods and tools designed to pass through that channel

parts.label: Guidance
parts.role: imaging, navigation or a robot to compensate for the reduced view

how.t: A small incision is made and a tubular retractor pushes muscle and soft tissue aside without cutting it.
The surgeon removes bone or disc and places implants (screws, rods) with instruments passed through the tube.
Smaller incisions are associated with less blood loss and faster recovery, but the surgeon's learning curve is steep.

word.why: VC angle: the bottleneck is no longer the implant but access to the OR — simplified kits, no capital outlay, robotic guidance. Companies that cut the operational friction of the minimally invasive route (Neo Medical) or automate it (robotics) attract capital; multicenter clinical proof is the next milestone.
